name: Evangeline Booth
source:
She'll do almost anything to get what she wants.

She's always wanted to be the center of attention, but never being able to go out of home alone or having the possibillity of making male friends, prevented her from it. So she's always envied her friends who could.

She's a heavy gamer known as Fiona2.0. She has a great voice and wants to someday become a singer. She also loves manga and anime.

[In game description]
